title: Marina Bay Sands
blurb: Moshe Safdie's 2010 integrated resort: three 55-storey, 195 m hotel towers crowned by the 340 m Sands SkyPark with its 150 m infinity pool, cantilevered 67 m beyond the north tower.

systems.name: Hotel towers
systems.description: The three 55-storey, 195 m hotel towers with 2,560 rooms, built as stacked shaft masses with podiums, crowns and lobbies.

systems.name: Glass curtain walls
systems.description: The glass curtain-wall facades wrapping each tower.

systems.name: Sands SkyPark
systems.description: The 340 m SkyPark deck at 200 m, built from 14 prefabricated steel segments, with edge beams and underside cladding.

systems.name: Infinity pool
systems.description: The 150 m infinity pool with its 145 m vanishing edge, catchment basin and decks.

systems.name: SkyPark gardens
systems.description: The 1.2-hectare tropical garden: tree clusters standing in for the 250 trees, planters for the 650 plants, lawns and the jogging path.

systems.name: Observation and dining
systems.description: The public observation deck with railings, restaurant pavilions and lounge.

systems.name: Engineering structure
systems.description: Shear cores, SkyPark support columns, the north cantilever truss, expansion joints and tuned mass dampers by Arup.

systems.name: ArtScience Museum
systems.description: The lotus-flower ArtScience Museum beside the towers, with its petal forms, skylight and lily pond.

systems.name: Podium and resort
systems.description: The resort podium: casino block with its atrium chandelier, the Shoppes with the sampan canal, convention center and theatre.
